_comment: Copy to ~/.devhawk/pm/workspace.json and fill in for YOUR Asana workspace. Everything here is workspace-specific: custom-field GIDs differ per workspace, the admin list is your team, and the OAuth app is yours. None of it is shipped with the plugin — it used to be, which both leaked our values into a public marketplace and made the kit unusable against any other workspace.
_requiredFields: GID -> display name for the custom fields every project must carry. Find them by reading one existing task's custom_fields, or the project's custom_field_settings, via the Asana API. Omit the block entirely and the field policy is skipped (hygiene reports that rather than attaching the wrong GIDs).
_requiredAdmins: Who must hold Admin on every project — at least two, so a project is never orphaned when someone leaves. asana-hygiene flags projects missing any of them. Find GIDs with: python3 asana_ops.py --find-user "<name or email>".
_oauth: Only needed for the OAuth login flow. The PAT path (export ASANA_PAT=...) needs none of this. Register an app at https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps with redirect http://localhost:8372/callback. ASANA_CLIENT_ID / ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment take precedence over these.
_options: Enum-option GIDs the hygiene auto-fill writes. Find them with: python3 asana_ops.py --hygiene <PROJECT_GID> --dry-run, or via the Asana API on each field.
_releaseOptions: Release enum options, {phase name: option gid}. Extended automatically as new phases are created with --add-release-option.
_defaultProjectOwnerGid: Owner assigned to index/portfolio projects this kit creates. Optional.
